package generated

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/attr"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/types"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/types/basetypes"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-go/tftypes"
)

func nestedValue(t *testing.T, ty attr.Type, state string) attr.Value {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	if state != "known" {
		var raw any
		if state == "unknown" {
			raw = tftypes.UnknownValue
		}
		value, err := ty.ValueFromTerraform(ctx, tftypes.NewValue(ty.TerraformType(ctx), raw))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return value
	}
	var value attr.Value
	switch typed := ty.(type) {
	case attr.TypeWithAttributeTypes:
		attributes := map[string]attr.Value{}
		for key, child := range typed.AttributeTypes() {
			attributes[key] = nestedValue(t, child, "known")
		}
		value = types.ObjectValueMust(typed.AttributeTypes(), attributes)
	case basetypes.ListType:
		value = types.ListValueMust(typed.ElemType, []attr.Value{nestedValue(t, typed.ElemType, "known")})
	case basetypes.MapType:
		value = types.MapValueMust(typed.ElemType, map[string]attr.Value{"first": nestedValue(t, typed.ElemType, "known")})
	case basetypes.SetType:
		value = types.SetValueMust(typed.ElemType, []attr.Value{nestedValue(t, typed.ElemType, "known")})
	case basetypes.StringType:
		value = types.StringValue("parser")
	default:
		t.Fatalf("unsupported fixture type %T", ty)
	}
	raw, err := value.ToTerraformValue(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	custom, err := ty.ValueFromTerraform(ctx, raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return custom
}

func TestNestedTypeRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	parentType := SCHEMA(ctx).Attributes["b"].GetType()
	fields := parentType.(attr.TypeWithAttributeTypes).AttributeTypes()
	childType := fields["columns"]
	if collection, ok := childType.(attr.TypeWithElementType); ok {
		childType = collection.ElementType()
	}
	childFields := childType.(attr.TypeWithAttributeTypes).AttributeTypes()
	if _, ok := childFields["field_parser_config"]; !ok {
		t.Fatal("parser branch lost field_parser_config")
	}
	if _, ok := childFields["expression"]; ok {
		t.Fatal("parser branch incorrectly uses expression")
	}
	for _, state := range []string{"known", "null", "unknown"} {
		t.Run(state, func(t *testing.T) {
			defer func() {
				if failure := recover(); failure != nil {
					t.Errorf("conversion panicked: %v", failure)
				}
			}()
			input := types.ObjectValueMust(fields, map[string]attr.Value{"columns": nestedValue(t, fields["columns"], state)})
			raw, err := input.ToTerraformValue(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			parent, err := parentType.ValueFromTerraform(ctx, raw)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			output, diagnostics := parent.(basetypes.ObjectValuable).ToObjectValue(ctx)
			if diagnostics.HasError() {
				t.Fatal(diagnostics)
			}
			roundTrip, err := output.ToTerraformValue(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !raw.Equal(roundTrip) {
				t.Fatalf("conversion changed the value: %s != %s", raw, roundTrip)
			}
		})
	}
}
